What it pins:

- "The changes in CNX 200, CNX 500, CNX Midcap and CNX Alpha index shall be effective from
  February 2, 2015 (close of January 30, 2015) and change in Nifty Midcap 50 index shall be
  effective from February 23, 2015" — so CNX 200 (ARVIND out, CRISIL in) and CNX 500 (ARVIND out,
  LAOPALA in) take effect 2015-02-02. The nearest-date-before rule dated them 2015-02-23.
- Its sections are numbered `1. CNX 200 index:` — a full stop, not a parenthesis. Before M14.1 no
  section of this release was read at all, and nothing said so.
